advancement.cesg.gateway_travel.desc: Travel to another dimension through a bound gateway
advancement.cesg.root.desc: Shulker logistics and cross-dimensional travel, the Create way
block.cesg.cross_dimensional_gateway_cor: Controls a _Gateway Frame_ ring. _Power_, _fuel_, and _bind_ it, then _walk through_ the portal to travel.
block.cesg.end_gateway.tooltip.summary: _End-only gateway_ — right-click to return to the _central island_.
block.cesg.ender_barrel.tooltip.summary: Crafted as twins: both barrels of a pair share the SAME 27 slots, across any distance or dimension. Hoppers and pipes work at either end, and barrels join _Storage Networks_ (each pair counted once). Unlike an Ender Chest, each pair is its own private pool — craft more pairs for more channels.
block.cesg.ender_infuser.tooltip.summary: Uses _rotational force_ and catalysts to convert teleportation fluids between recipe stages.
Buffers _gateway fuel_ beside a _Gateway ring_ and keeps the _Core_ topped up so bursty travel and Port transfers never run the gateway dry. Single-fuel like a _fluid tank_ (locks to the first fuel piped in); _stack them into a 2×2×2 or 3×3×3 array_ for more capacity.
block.cesg.gateway_frame.tooltip.summary: Build a _vertical ring_ of these around one _Gateway Core_ to form a walk-through portal. Leave _a block of space_ between neighbouring gateways — rings whose frames touch break each other.
block.cesg.gateway_port.tooltip.summary: Cross-gateway logistics endpoint. Place beside a _Gateway Frame_ or _Core_; piped-in items and fluids emerge from a Gateway Port on the bound partner ring while the gateway is powered and fueled.
block.cesg.shulker_belt_loader.tooltip.s: Extends a hose to _load a docked shulker_ from a belt two blocks below.
block.cesg.shulker_belt_unloader.tooltip: Extends a hose to _unload a docked shulker_ onto a belt two blocks below.
block.cesg.shulker_cage.tooltip.behaviou: _Right-click a live shulker_ with the cage to place it and _capture_ the mob.
A _redstone-powered_ cage fires on a nearby _occupied cage_, knocking a _Shulker Shell_ loose on a short cooldown.
Any real _shulker bullet_ hitting an occupied cage in the _End_ knocks a _shell_ loose (same cooldown) — wild shulker crossfire is free shells.
_Right-click_ an occupied cage with an _empty hand_ to free the shulker.
block.cesg.shulker_cage.tooltip.conditio: When struck by a shulker bullet
block.cesg.shulker_cage.tooltip.summary: _Traps_ a live shulker for _End_ shell farming, like vanilla duplication.
block.cesg.shulker_loader.tooltip.summar: Docks a _shulker box_ and loads it from adjacent item automation.
block.cesg.shulker_unloader.tooltip.summ: Docks a _shulker box_ and extracts its contents into adjacent item automation.
block.cesg.storage_bridge.tooltip.summar: Links two _Storage Networks_ through a bound gateway. Place beside a _Gateway Frame_ or _Core_ that is _adjacent to a Storage Network_; a matching Bridge on the partner ring surfaces that network's items on this side's _Storage Terminal_ as a separate section. Moves items _both ways_ with per-side filters while the gateway is powered and fueled.
block.cesg.storage_network_controller.to: Anchors a storage network. _Enhanced Shulker Boxes_, _Shulker Stations_, and _Storage Terminals_ touching the controller (or each other) join the network automatically.
block.cesg.storage_terminal.tooltip.summ: Searchable window into a storage network. Click items to withdraw; shift-click your inventory to deposit. Must touch a network that contains a _Storage Network Controller_.
cesg.barrel.unpaired: Unpaired — placing one tags the rest of the stack as its twins
cesg.battery.fuel_added: Added %s mB to the Flux Battery
cesg.battery.fuel_drained: Drained %s mB from the Flux Battery
cesg.battery.gauge_moved: Charge gauge moved to the %s face

cesg.battery.wrong_fuel: Battery is locked to %s — empty it first
cesg.bridge.blacklist.tip: Blacklist: every item moves except the filtered ones (empty = everything).
cesg.bridge.enable.tip: Toggle unattended auto-transfer in this direction. Idle = no fuel cost.
cesg.bridge.filter.hint: Click with an item to filter this direction (the item is not consumed).
cesg.bridge.gui.title: Storage Bridge
cesg.bridge.lock.tip: Locked: other gateways cannot pull items OUT of this network. This Bridge can still push out, the far side can still deposit in, and its terminal can still see the contents. Only Bridges here are affected — other networks keep working as before.
cesg.bridge.push.routed.tip: Route mode is on for this gateway, so this filter is ignored — the Core's per-channel filters decide where each item goes. Turn Route off on the Core to use this row.
cesg.bridge.whitelist.tip: Whitelist: only the filtered items move (empty = nothing).
cesg.crystal.empty: Not imprinted — sneak + use on a Gateway Core
cesg.gateway.bound_success_channel_repla: Gateway bound on channel %s (partner channel %s) — previous binding replaced
cesg.gateway.chunkload_tooltip: While ON, this gateway keeps its own chunk and the bound destination's chunk loaded and ticking — Gateway Port transfers keep flowing with nobody on either side. Follows the active channel: switching destinations moves the loading with it.
cesg.gateway.crystal_empty: Binding crystal is empty — sneak + use on a gateway to imprint
cesg.gateway.crystal_imprinted: Binding crystal imprinted with this gateway
cesg.gateway.crystal_self: Cannot bind a gateway to itself
cesg.gateway.end_only: Native gateway physics only function in the End
cesg.gateway.fallback: Partner offline — emergency route to central island
cesg.gateway.filter.blacklist.tip: Blacklist: every item routes to this channel except these (empty = all).
cesg.gateway.filter.hint: Click with an item to filter this channel (the item is not consumed).
cesg.gateway.filter.title: Channel %s Filter
cesg.gateway.filter.whitelist.tip: Whitelist: only these items route to this channel (empty = none).
cesg.gateway.no_frame: No gateway frame — build a complete Gateway Frame rectangle (corners included) with the Core as one of its blocks
cesg.gateway.ready: Gateway ready — walk through the portal to travel
cesg.gateway.route_tooltip: Route mode: a Gateway Port or Storage Bridge fans each item out to whichever bound channel's filter accepts it, instead of only the active channel. Right-click a channel to edit its filter. Fluids and manual/terminal moves still use the active channel.
cesg.gateway.tank_empty: Not enough fuel to fill a bucket
cesg.gateway.unbound: Gateway is not bound to a partner

cesg.goggles.shulker_cage.end_only: End dimension required for shell drops
cesg.goggles.shulker_cage.ready: Ready — power it near another cage to drop shells
cesg.goggles.shulker_cage.trap_hint: Use the cage on a live shulker to trap it
cesg.goggles.station.filter_chain_insert: Loaders require items to pass the station filter, then the shulker filter
cesg.goggles.station.filter_hint: Click any front or side filter slot with an item or Create filter
cesg.goggles.station.filter_reject_extra: Non-matching items stay in the shulker until the station filter allows them

cesg.network.box_locked: This box is part of a storage network — use a Storage Terminal, or pick the box up
cesg.network.remote.locked: That network is locked — its Bridge does not allow items to be taken
cesg.network.remote.unfuelled: Not enough gateway fuel — a Flux Battery is holding back the travel reserve
cesg.network.status: Network: %s member blocks, %s inventories, %s item types
cesg.ponder.cross_dimensional_gateway_co: Build a vertical Gateway Frame ring with the Core as one of its blocks
Pump Liquid Eye of Ender into any frame to fuel and light the ring
The Core's glass eye fills with the fuel it is holding
Powered and bound, the interior opens into a portal
cesg.ponder.ender_infuser.text_1: Supply rotational force and pipe a recipe fluid into the Infuser
cesg.ponder.ender_infuser.text_2: Catalysts ride in on a belt and the funnel feeds them to the Infuser
cesg.ponder.ender_infuser.text_3: The infused fluid is pumped out into the tank above
cesg.ponder.gateway_flux_battery.text_1: A Gateway Flux Battery stores gateway fuel beside the ring
cesg.ponder.gateway_flux_battery.text_2: Pump Liquid Eye of Ender or Teleport Essence in — the window and gauge fill as it charges
cesg.ponder.gateway_flux_battery.text_3: While it holds fuel, the battery keeps the Gateway Core topped up
cesg.ponder.gateway_flux_battery_array.t: A lone Gateway Flux Battery is a 1x1x1 tank holding one block of fuel
A 2x2 footprint stacks two high: eight blocks merged into one 2x2x2 tank
A 3x3 footprint stacks three high — the largest array, holding twenty-seven blocks
Any face of the array accepts fuel, and one face carries the charge gauge
cesg.ponder.shulker_belt_loader.text_1: The Shulker Belt Loader sits two blocks above a belt
cesg.ponder.shulker_belt_loader.text_2: Its hose extends down to draw items off the belt into a shulker
cesg.ponder.shulker_belt_loader.text_3: The filled shulker then drops from the funnel onto an item drain
cesg.ponder.shulker_belt_unloader.text_1: A full shulker box is fed into the Belt Unloader from above
cesg.ponder.shulker_belt_unloader.text_2: Its hose extends down toward the belt below
cesg.ponder.shulker_belt_unloader.text_3: It drops the shulker's contents onto the belt to be carried away
cesg.ponder.shulker_loader.text_1: An empty shulker box drops in from above and docks in the Shulker Loader
cesg.ponder.shulker_loader.text_2: Items ride in on a belt and the funnel loads them into the docked box
cesg.ponder.shulker_loader.text_3: When full, the loaded shulker ejects onto the output belt
cesg.ponder.shulker_unloader.text_1: A full shulker box docks in the Shulker Unloader
cesg.ponder.shulker_unloader.text_2: Its contents are pushed out through the funnel onto a belt
cesg.ponder.shulker_unloader.text_3: The empty shulker then drops down into storage below
cesg.ponder.storage_bridge.text_1: Attach a Storage Bridge to a powered, bound Gateway ring
cesg.ponder.storage_bridge.text_2: Its gauge reads OFFLINE until a matching Bridge on the far ring answers
cesg.ponder.storage_bridge.text_3: A green LIVE gauge means the pair is up — filtered items cross the Gateway
cesg.ponder.storage_bridge.text_4: If the partner Bridge is missing or unloaded the gauge turns amber and reads FAULT
cesg.ponder.storage_network_controller.t: The Storage Network Controller anchors a cluster of adjacent storage blocks
Place it touching the Bridge to expose that storage to the Gateway
Right-click the Controller to read back the network's size and contents
cesg.ponder.storage_terminal.text_1: The Storage Terminal is the console for a Controller's network
cesg.ponder.storage_terminal.text_2: It must touch a cluster that contains a Storage Network Controller
cesg.ponder.storage_terminal.text_3: Open it to browse local stock and, across a Bridge, the remote network's contents
cesg.ponder.tag.end_storage.description: Shulker automation, ender processing, and the cross-dimensional Gateway network
cesg.station.fullness.label: Eject When
cesg.station.name.label: Name
cesg.station.needs_belt: Belt stations sit two blocks above a Create belt — aim at the belt to place
cesg.station.retention.label: Shulker Retention
cesg.tooltip.warp_resistance: Resists teleportation — ender pearls, blinks, enderman grabs, and gateway travel. Walking through Nether/End portals still works.
item.cesg.compacting_upgrade.tooltip.beh: _Merges partial stacks_ immediately in the GUI; automation merges up to _64 items_ per pass.
item.cesg.compacting_upgrade.tooltip.sum: _Combines_ partial stacks automatically when installed in an _Enhanced Shulker_.
item.cesg.crushing_upgrade_t1.tooltip.su: A PLACED box _crushes and mills_ its contents using Create recipes (ores → crushed ore, cobble → gravel → sand), chaining to the final form. _1 conversion/sec_. Only the highest-tier crushing module applies.
item.cesg.crushing_upgrade_t2.tooltip.su: A PLACED box _crushes and mills_ its contents, chaining to the final form, at _2 conversions/sec_. Only the highest-tier crushing module applies.
item.cesg.crushing_upgrade_t3.tooltip.su: A PLACED box _crushes and mills_ its contents, chaining to the final form, at _4 conversions/sec_. Only the highest-tier crushing module applies.
item.cesg.emergency_eye_charge.tooltip.s: _Consumable escape_ — teleports you to the _End central island_ from any dimension.
item.cesg.ender_pearl_dust.tooltip.summa: Finely _crushed Ender Pearl_ used to begin CESG's liquid teleportation chain.
item.cesg.enhanced_shulker_box.tooltip.s: _Enhanced_ shulker storage with sidebar _upgrade modules_. _Tier 2_ has _54 slots_; craft _tier upgrades_ to reach _81_ and _108_ slots.
item.cesg.filter_upgrade.tooltip.behavio: Click the _filter slot_ with any item or _Create filter_ to set it as configuration — the item is _not consumed_. Empty-hand click clears. Station filters still apply first.
item.cesg.filter_upgrade.tooltip.summary: _Restricts_ which items can enter storage when installed in an _Enhanced Shulker_.
item.cesg.gateway_binding_item.tooltip.b: _Sneak + use_ on a gateway core to store its coordinates on the crystal.
_Use_ an imprinted crystal on a second gateway to bind them together.
item.cesg.gateway_binding_item.tooltip.s: Links two _Cross-Dimensional Gateway Cores_ across dimensions.
item.cesg.liquid_ender_pearl_bucket.tool: A volatile _teleporting liquid_ and precursor for _Teleport Essence_.
item.cesg.liquid_eye_of_ender_bucket: Bucket of Liquid Eye of Ender
item.cesg.liquid_eye_of_ender_bucket.too: _Cross-dimensional gateway fuel_ — mix _Teleport Essence_ + _Blaze Powder_ in a heated basin.
item.cesg.magnet_upgrade_t1.tooltip.summ: A PLACED box pulls in dropped items it can accept within _4 blocks_. Only the highest-tier magnet module applies.
item.cesg.magnet_upgrade_t2.tooltip.summ: A PLACED box pulls in dropped items it can accept within _7 blocks_, faster. Only the highest-tier magnet module applies.
item.cesg.magnet_upgrade_t3.tooltip.summ: A PLACED box pulls in dropped items it can accept within _10 blocks_, fastest. Only the highest-tier magnet module applies.
item.cesg.shulker_shell.tooltip.behaviou: _Refine_ a Shulker Shell — farm shells with a _Shulker Cage_ in the _End_, then _process_ them into this.
item.cesg.shulker_shell.tooltip.summary: _Refined_ shulker shell used in _Enhanced Shulker_ tier upgrades and Create machines.
item.cesg.smelting_upgrade.tooltip.summa: Items inserted into the box are stored as their _furnace result_ — ores arrive as ingots, food arrives cooked. Items without a smelting recipe store unchanged.
item.cesg.stack_depth_upgrade_t1.tooltip: Only modules in the _upgrade sidebar_ activate; spares kept in main storage are _inert_.
_Raises stack limits to 128_ per slot when installed in an _Enhanced Shulker_.
item.cesg.stack_depth_upgrade_t2.tooltip: Only the _highest-tier_ stack depth module applies if several are installed.
_Raises stack limits to 256_ per slot when installed in an _Enhanced Shulker_.
item.cesg.stack_depth_upgrade_t3.tooltip: Only the _highest-tier_ stack depth module applies if several are installed.
_Raises stack limits to 512_ per slot when installed in an _Enhanced Shulker_.
item.cesg.teleport_essence_bucket.toolti: _Same-dimension gateway fuel_ — mix _Liquid Ender Pearl_ + _Chorus Fruit_ in a heated basin.
item.cesg.void_upgrade.tooltip.summary: Overflow of item types the box already stores is _destroyed_ instead of rejected. Types the box does not store are still rejected normally — a full box is not a trash can. Click the module's _crimson config slot_ with an item to void ONLY matching overflow (independent of the storage filter).
item.cesg.washing_upgrade_t1.tooltip.sum: A PLACED box _washes_ its contents using Create splashing recipes (gravel → flint, sand → clay, crushed ores → nuggets), chaining to the final form. _1 conversion/sec_. Only the highest-tier washing module applies.
item.cesg.washing_upgrade_t2.tooltip.sum: A PLACED box _washes_ its contents, chaining to the final form, at _2 conversions/sec_. Only the highest-tier washing module applies.
item.cesg.washing_upgrade_t3.tooltip.sum: A PLACED box _washes_ its contents, chaining to the final form, at _4 conversions/sec_. Only the highest-tier washing module applies.
